description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceLimón y Playa is a one-bedroom, 2 full-bath luxury villa with a private plunge pool. The villa is steps away from a stunning infinity pool, and the beach is a one-minute walk away. On this beach, you can enjoy a morning or afternoon dip, appreciate the scenery and let the waves caress your feet. If you are looking to relax, enjoy quiet surroundings, and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer a short drive away, then this is the place for you! IMPORTANT NOTE #1: This villa is not located at The Horned Dorset Hotel (which is closed). It is located at the Villas at Horned Dorset, directly beside the hotel. The common areas and pool of the Villas are in pristine condition. Once you get off the main road, you will encounter narrow countryside roads for approx 3-5 minutes until you get to the property.IMPORTANT NOTE #2: The complex offers a full-size generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service. IMPORTANT NOTE #3 - PLUNGE POOL MAINTENANCE: The pool man has to access the outdoor patio every Thursday during the morning to clean the plunge pool. No exceptions. Guests do not need to be at the property for this, since they don't need access to the unit. Please reach out to us before booking if you have any questions regarding this service.LIVING AREAYou will love the way the living area seamlessly integrates the beautiful plunge pool and garden views. There is a 2-person dining table and central AC. The room is elegantly furnished and has a TV for sophisticated relaxation by the Caribbean Sea. The living and dining room opens to the terrace via two gorgeous wooden doors. The terrace has a private plunge pool overlooking a tropical garden with a 2-person dining table, great for having breakfast, lunch, or a romantic dinner. There are two lounge chairs for sunbathing in privacy.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite is located on the second level of the villa. Upstairs, the views get even better. The villa offers a four-poster mahogany king-size bed, Amalfi ceramics, hand-carved furniture, and a separate sitting area. The grand suite has a luxurious bathroom covered from floor to ceiling with Carrara marble and features a beautiful oversized freestanding white porcelain bathtub, a shower, and His & Hers sinks. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENETTEThe kitchenette is located on the 1st level of the villa. It offers a small refrigerator, toaster, microwave oven, a single burner portable stovetop, coffee maker, a blender, and basic pots and pans for simple cooking. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation.The villa includes one (1) unassigned parking spot.LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the secluded beach, private plunge pool, and infinity pool at The Villas at The Horned Dorset. This oceanfront property has a private area where guests can wet their feet in the ocean and soak up the sun. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle BoardsOther things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish spongePlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 2 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

title: Beachfront Luxury Corner Penthouse w/ Sunset Views
description: Experience true luxury at Playa Delirio, a stunning beachfront corner penthouse located in Sol y Playa, a gated seaside community right on Los Almendros Beach, the best beach in Rincón. This exquisite, professionally decorated two-level retreat, with breathtaking panoramic ocean views and direct beach access, features 3 gorgeous bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2 beach-facing balconies, and an expansive terrace, offering everything needed for a perfect getaway. Truly, relaxing sophistication in paradise!The spaceThere’s nothing quite like Playa Delirio! Your dream getaway awaits at the Sol y Playa condominium, located in the tranquil and exclusive Córcega ward of Rincón, just 5 minutes from the town center and all the incredible dining and nightlife options Rincón has to offer.Playa Delirio is designed specifically for adults, offering a sophisticated and tranquil escape. Adults may bring accompanying teenagers aged 13 and older, but for safety reasons, children under the age of 13 are not permitted. This two-level, fully air-conditioned beachfront corner penthouse offers an unparalleled luxury experience, serving as your home away from home with breathtaking ocean views and direct access to Los Almendros Beach, known for its soft sands and calm, crystal-clear turquoise waters.Featuring 3 beautifully appointed bedrooms—2 with plush king beds and 1 with a cozy queen bed—this penthouse comfortably hosts all your needs. With 2 full bathrooms and a convenient powder room, you’ll have ample space for relaxation. The apartment also offers 2 assigned private parking spaces within the secure gated parking area and includes a laundry room within the space for guest use.Indulge in the spacious living room, family room with a large TV for entertainment, and dining area, all thoughtfully designed for your comfort. The full kitchen, equipped with modern appliances, is perfect for preparing delicious meals. The 2 beach-facing balconies provide ideal spots to unwind and take in the most stunning sunsets you’ve ever seen! Enjoy breakfast al fresco at the outdoor nook or lounge on the daybed while soaking up the ocean views.Step outside to the second-level rooftop terrace, the only one in the complex with spectacular beach views. This exclusive space features outdoor dining and seating furniture, making it the perfect setting for sunset dinners or simply lounging with a good book.Every detail of Playa Delirio has been meticulously curated by a professional decorator, ensuring a high-end experience that elevates your beach getaway. Whether you seek relaxation or adventure, this two-level penthouse is your gateway to the best of Rincón—with every detail in mind!Unwind, recharge, and experience the serene beauty of Los Almendros Beach at Playa Delirio—your perfect escape awaits!🗓️ Extended stay (28+ days) discounts are available. We accept extended stays generally during low season months (May to September). These stays will include complimentary weekly cleaning. 🫧Guest accessWe want you to enjoy your stay to the fullest, and we’re pleased to inform you that the entire property is at your disposal, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing experience.The penthouse apartment is located on the 3rd level of the building and is conveniently accessed by two easy flights of stairs, with no elevator. Also, the apartment has an interior, private staircase that connects boths levels of the apartment.If you have any questions or need recommendations for restaurants, bars, shops, in-home chefs and masseuses during your stay, please don’t hesitate to ask. Enjoy your time at Playa Delirio, and make the most of your beachfront getaway!Other things to noteA Friendly Note on Utilities:Just a heads-up! The property has a private water cistern in case of any water service hiccups. While this rarely happens, it’s good to know that clean water is available for the entire apartment if needed. The complex does have a power generator that lights up all communal areas, but it does not power the apartment itself. In the event of a power loss, guests will need to be flexible and open windows and doors for ventilation until power is restored.In case of a power outage, each bedroom is equipped with a backup battery that powers a provided tower fan as an alternate source of ventilation when the A/Cs are not operational, and can also charge cell phones. These fans will run throughout the night to ensure comfort. Additionally, the refrigerator has its own backup battery that will keep it running for over 24 hours.Battery-powered lanterns are also provided in each bedroom for illumination, and both the stairway and under-cabinet lighting in the kitchen are battery-powered to ensure continued visibility throughout the home.Please note that any outages of power or water are beyond the control of the owners and managers of the property, as they pertain to the local authorities of power and water. We’re sharing this information so you know what to expect and can have a comfortable stay with us.

title: My Happy Place - Beach Front
description: A stunning beachfront apartment on the first floor of the complex. Enjoy spectacular sunset views from the comfort of your balcony. This is a very peaceful apartment complex. Private beach access is a few steps down. This is a relaxing spot where you can enjoy coastal living. This spot is close to downtown Rincon, to surf and sightseeing spots, restaurants, and much more. We bring the beach to your feet.The spaceThe property is a beachfront apartment in a gated community called Sol y Playa, in Playa Los Almendros, Rincón, Puerto Rico. It is a completely furnished and equipped apartment.This beautiful space has a private furnished balcony to enjoy the stunning sunsets Rincón has to offer.The master bedroom has a king bed, a private bathroom, and a walk-in closet.The second bedroom has a three-bed bunk bed. Two twin beds and one full bed.The second bathroom is located next to the second room.Both bedrooms have air conditioning units.The living room area has a smart TV with high-speed WIFI.The dining and kitchen areas have an air conditioning unit and one ceiling fan.This unit also provides a private laundry room.The unit is completely equipped.Table games, beach chairs, and beach towels are provided to our guests.Two back-to-back parking spotsNOTE TO GUESTS: As a result of hurricane Maria in September 2017, recreational areas were severely damaged. Reconstruction has started, but it has been halted until further notice.Guest accessIt is highly recommended to rent a car. Rincon is located on the lower northwest corner of Puerto Rico in the area known as the Porta del Sol, approximately 2.5 – 3 hours driving time from the capital city of San Juan (SJU) and a 45 minute driving time from Aguadilla Airport (BQN).Allied, Budget, and Avis car rental companies all offer locations at the San Juan Airport and the Aguadilla (BQN) Puerto Rico Airport. Budget car rental also offers a location in Añasco/Mayaguez which is only about 20 minutes from Rincon. This makes returns, pick-ups, car exchanges, or handling any necessary issues quick and easy.Rincon is easily accessed off of a major highway which makes visiting a breeze, yet set back enough to retain its signature secluded, small-town vibe.The apartment has two back-to-back gated parking.Distance from the property to:Sandy Beach- 16 minutesDomes Beach-14 minutesMaria's Beach-12 minutesTres Palmas Beach (Steps)-11 minutesOther things to noteNOTE TO GUESTS: As a result of hurricane Maria in September 2017, recreational areas were severely damaged. Reconstruction has started, but it has been halted until further notice.
